title: Idempotency Hardening + Duplicate Auth Cleanup

findings.description: POST /api/decisions/create had zero idempotency protection. Network retries silently created duplicate governed OperatorItem records. Affected single JSON, bulk JSON, and CSV paths.
findings.fix: Added idempotency-key header requirement and checkIdempotencyKey / recordIdempotencyResponse / recordIdempotencyError wrapping around all three code paths.

findings.description: POST /api/decisions/intake had zero idempotency protection. Additionally, db.workspaceMembership.findFirst had no orderBy clause making workspace selection non-deterministic for multi-workspace users.
findings.fix: Added idempotency-key header requirement and full idempotency pattern. Added orderBy: { createdAt: 'asc' } to workspace findFirst for determinism.

findings.description: Three state-transition routes using withCanonicalEnforcement had no idempotency-key requirement. Network retries after the CAS commit returned ValidationError instead of a cached success, violating the idempotency contract established by execute/route.ts.
findings.fix: Added idempotency-key requirement and route-level check/record pattern to accept, reject, close.

findings.description: Three state-transition routes using withEnforcementFull + inner withAuth() had no idempotency-key requirement. Same retry-gets-error failure mode as F3.
findings.fix: Added idempotency-key requirement and route-level check/record pattern to fail, verify, record-outcome. Removed unused getSession import from fail and record-outcome.

findings.description: db.workspaceMembership.findFirst with no orderBy — non-deterministic workspace selection for users with multiple active workspaces.
findings.fix: Added orderBy: { createdAt: 'asc' } — always selects oldest active workspace, deterministic across calls.

findings.description: Duplicate session resolution: outer wrapper and inner withAuth() both resolve the same session. Redundant DB round-trip per request. Not a security defect.
findings.fix: DUPLICATE_AUTH_ROUTE_INVENTORY.md documents the full classification. Migration to withCanonicalEnforcement planned for a future phase.

testsAdded.coverage: intake: missing key denied, first creates, retry cached, cached-error replay, workspace orderBy, audit-fail records error | create: missing key denied, single creates+records, single retry cached, single error recorded, workspace in payload | accept: missing key denied, first calls service+records, retry cached, error recorded | close: missing key denied, first calls service+records, retry cached, error recorded
Updated (not new tests): added headers mock to makeIntakeRequest, added ValidationError to error mock to support Phase 6I intake route changes

schemaChanges: None — all fixes are application-layer only
productionMigrationRequiredPhrase: I approve running the production migration
